instructions: Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Anyone working remotely has to supply their own reliable internet connection, running at (25) ........ or better.
items.evidence: Provide their own reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps.
items.explanation: Text B, paragraph B says remote workers must provide their own reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps; so the answer is '10 Mbps'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Staff can only ask to work from home once they have got through their (25) ........
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Employees who have completed their probationary period may apply to work remotely for up to three days per week, subject to line manager approval and the operational needs of their team.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Model parcasiz uc turda da 'probation period' verdi: ayni kelimenin baska cekimi, yani cevabin ('probationary period') ayirt edici ogesi tam olarak tutturuldu. Sorunun ekseni 'uzaktan calisma basvurusundan once neyin tamamlanmasi gerekir' ve bunun cevabi ise alma dunyasinin en yerlesik kuralidir; kanit cumlesi (B metni, A/1) baska hicbir on kosul icermiyor, dolayisiyla her cerceve ayni kavrami istiyor. E6 onerisi: ayni cumlenin sayisal siniri (haftada en cok uc gun) ya da A/2'deki musteriyle calisan roller istisnasi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru B metni A/1'e capaliydi; model parcasiz uc turda da 'probation period' vererek cevabin ayirt edici ogesini tutturdu, cunku uzaktan calisma basvurusunun on kosulu ise alma dunyasinin en yerlesik kurali. Yeni soru A paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit B/2'ye, baglanti hizi kosuluna tasindi. Sayi sirket yonergesine ozgu.

items.prompt: Whether they are at home or in the office, employees have to be reachable by phone or video call from 10 a.m. until (26) ........
items.evidence: Core hours for all staff, whether remote or office-based, are 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., during which employees must be reachable by phone or video call.
items.explanation: Paragraph C of text B says core hours for all staff, remote or office-based, run from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., and that employees must be reachable by phone or video call during them; the answer is therefore '4 p.m.'.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: GT2 okuma - isaretli kalem elden gecirme (2026-08-18)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The cost of (26) ........ that has been approved can be claimed back, but not more than £150 in any one year.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Claim reimbursement for approved home-office equipment, up to £150 per year, through the expenses system.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: bosluk bir kalibin ucuna aciliyordu ve kok tek basina okundugunda cevabin bas adi zorunlu olarak cikiyordu -- uzaktan calisma yonergesinde masrafi geri odenen seyin adi 'equipment' olur. Anlam duzeyi olcumunde model uc turun ucunde de 'office equipment' verdi. Onceki turda 'cerceve ne yapilirsa yapilsin ayni bas ad okunur' denip kalem oldugu gibi birakilmisti; bu turda karar degisti, cunku sizintiyi kapatmanin tek yolu boslugun HEDEFINI degistirmek.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk kalibin ucundan alinip metnin kendi sectigi bir DEGERE acildi: kanit B metni B/5'ten C/1'e, cekirdek calisma saatlerine tasindi ve cevap bir saat oldu. Kok metinsiz okundugunda ('10 a.m. until ___') hicbir tek aday cikmiyor; ustelik genel kultur yanlis yone cekiyor, cunku beklenen mesai bitisi 5 ya da 6, metindeki deger 4. Butce: C paragrafinda artik iki soru var (23-24 ve 26), C/1 cumlesi daha once bos idi. GT1'in not tamamlamasiyla capraz kok cakismasi olan 'four weeks' dizgisi bilerek kullanilmadi (o dizgi bu dosyada 27. kalemde duruyor ve baska bir ajanin isi).

items.prompt: Permission to work from another country is seldom given for a stretch of longer than (27) ........
items.evidence: Working from outside the country is not permitted without separate written approval from both HR and the relevant country office, and such approval is rarely granted for periods longer than four weeks.
items.explanation: Paragraph D of text B says that permission to work from abroad is rarely granted for periods longer than four weeks; the answer is therefore 'four weeks'.
